name.zh: WE-T214 三合一土壤传感器变送器

manufacturer.en: Hainan World Electronic Science And Technology Co., Ltd.
manufacturer.zh: 海南世电科技有限公司

description.en: Industrial soil transmitter for Temperature, Moisture, and EC monitoring with dual 4G and LoRa connectivity, IP67 enclosure, and GNSS positioning.
description.zh: 工业级土壤变送器，用于温度、湿度和电导率（EC）监测，支持4G和LoRa双通信，IP67防护等级，内置GNSS定位。

lead.en: A rugged, field-ready transmitter for precision agriculture. Simultaneously monitors soil temperature, volumetric moisture content, and electrical conductivity (EC). Supports dual 4G and LoRa connectivity for reliable data backhaul in remote areas.
lead.zh: 一款坚固耐用的野外型变送器，适用于精准农业。同时监测土壤温度、体积含水率和电导率（EC），支持4G和LoRa双通信，确保偏远地区数据可靠回传。

product.og_description: Integrated soil monitor for Temp, Moisture, and EC with dual 4G/LoRa connectivity.

images.alt: WE-T214 full set with sensor probe
WE-T214 host back view and antenna
WE-T214 LCD screen with real-time readings
Soil Parameter Tester mobile app interface

text.en: Monitors Soil Temperature, Volumetric Moisture Content, and Electrical Conductivity (EC) simultaneously with a high-accuracy triple-probe sensor.
text.zh: 通过高精度三合一探针，同时监测土壤温度、体积含水率和电导率（EC）。

text.en: Flexible connectivity with 4G LTE (MQTT/HTTP) and LoRa (up to 5km range), ensuring data reporting even in extremely remote locations.
text.zh: 灵活选择4G LTE（MQTT/HTTP）或LoRa（最远5km）通信方式，即使在偏远地区也能确保数据上报。

text.en: Built-in GPS/GLONASS/BDS support for automated asset tracking and mapping of soil data across large plantations.
text.zh: 内置GPS/GLONASS/BDS支持，自动追踪设备位置并在大型种植园中绘制土壤数据地图。

text.en: Powered by a 19,000mAh high-capacity lithium battery or optional 40W solar panel for years of maintenance-free operation.
text.zh: 采用19000mAh大容量锂电池或可选40W太阳能板供电，实现多年免维护运行。

text.en: IP67-rated host and IP68-rated probe enclosure. Engineered for harsh agricultural environments from -40°C to +85°C.
text.zh: 主机IP67防护，探针IP68防护，专为-40°C至+85°C的严苛农业环境设计。

text.en: On-site data viewing via a high-contrast display. View temperature, humidity, and EC levels directly without a mobile device.
text.zh: 通过高对比度显示屏现场查看数据，无需移动设备即可直接读取温度、湿度和EC值。

value.en: Soil Temperature, Soil Moisture, Soil Conductivity (EC)
value.zh: 土壤温度、土壤湿度、土壤电导率（EC）

value.en: LTE FDD B1/3/5/7/20/28; MQTT, HTTP, WEST cloud
9-30V DC (Typ 24V), 19,000mAh Internal Li-battery, or 40W Solar Panel
value.zh: 9-30V DC（典型24V），19000mAh内置锂电池，或40W太阳能板

value.en: Transmitter Host: IP67; Sensor Probe: IP68
value.zh: 变送器主机：IP67；传感器探针：IP68

text.en: Automated soil monitoring for greenhouse farming, orchards, and open fields to optimize irrigation cycles and fertilizer application based on real-time EC and moisture data.
text.zh: 为温室种植、果园和大田提供自动化土壤监测，基于实时EC和湿度数据优化灌溉周期和施肥方案。

text.en: Long-term research on soil salinity and moisture dynamics in ecological conservation areas, leveraging LoRa for data transmission across remote terrain.
text.zh: 在生态保护区进行土壤盐分和湿度动态的长期研究，利用LoRa实现远程地形数据传输。
